registers.name: CFG_GEOMETRY_SOURCE
registers.description: Firmware-visible geometry source metadata, mirroring cfg_geometry_source input. Value is captured by the RTL only through the top-level port; this register is for software traceability and programming intent.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_SOURCE
fields.description: Vehicle geometry source metadata. Encoded value is implementation-defined but must remain stable for verification.

registers.name: CFG_GEOMETRY_FORMAT
registers.description: Firmware-visible geometry format metadata, mirroring cfg_geometry_format input.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_FORMAT
fields.description: Vehicle geometry format metadata. Encoded value is implementation-defined but stable.

registers.name: CFG_GEOMETRY_ID_LO
registers.description: Low byte of geometry identifier metadata, mirroring cfg_geometry_id input.

registers.name: CFG_GEOMETRY_ID_HI
registers.description: High byte of geometry identifier metadata, mirroring cfg_geometry_id input.

registers.name: FLOW_VELOCITY_LO
registers.description: Low byte of the sampled stream velocity presented to the request supervisor.

registers.name: FLOW_VELOCITY_HI
registers.description: High byte of the sampled stream velocity presented to the request supervisor.

registers.description: Traceability register for the current or most recently issued request ID.

registers.name: REQ_ID_HI
registers.description: Traceability register for the current or most recently issued request ID.

registers.name: RSP_ID_LO
registers.description: Traceability register for the most recently observed response ID.

registers.name: RSP_ID_HI
registers.description: Traceability register for the most recently observed response ID.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_CMD_LO
